mating-face.src: Original generic sealed 3-way mating/rear illustration; synthetic example, 24 × 17 mm frame, 6 mm cavity spacing and colors inferred. Male mating face mirrors female, rear pins mirror the mating anchors. Not a manufacturer product or dimensional drawing; CC0-1.0.
